open_questions.question: How is the Wedded Advisor fee worked out (flat fee, percentage or other), what does 'start to finish' cover, and does Wedded Wonderland take a commission or margin on resort or supplier quotes (are 'quotes in AUD' the venue's own prices converted)? The sceptic said a missing fee page takes Wedded Wonderland off the list.

Who is accountable on the wedding day, is it someone the couple has met, and who answers out of hours if something goes wrong during the trip? Raised by planner_couple and funding_parent ('who do I ring at 2am'); deferred in brand-facts.md.

Is there a private or referral-only channel to speak with someone senior rather than a general enquiry form, does the first contact start with a call, and can the paying parent join it? Raised by uhnw (would not click) and funding_parent.

Scale and security: has Wedded Wonderland delivered weddings of 200 to 400 guests, and how does it work with a family's private security, the venue's security and photo or press leaks? Raised by uhnw; deferred in brand-facts.md.

payload.rationale: The reader is comparing (01-brief.json), so every commercial invitation goes to a Wedded Concierge consultation at /wonderland-concierge, and each sits after the evidence it follows, which the sceptic named as right. The primary link closes the guest travel section, where the long-haul journey, entry rules and Smartraveller safety advice have raised the question of how to set a date that works for guests from Australia. The secondary link follows the six venue questions and turns them into a concrete reason to talk ('put these questions to the venues on your shortlist'); its lead-in carries the brand-facts reassurances (inclusions confirmed in writing, your time zone, quotes in AUD), with the panel's 'advisor_covered' edit answering planner_couple's hidden-costs fear from an allowed claim. The closing section repeats the invitation with 'one Wedded Advisor, start to finish, as your single point of contact'. The /magazine link serves planner_couple and search_visitor, who said they would read more or bookmark before enquiring. All four links are kept exactly as placed, anchor 'Wedded Concierge' (2 words, no exclamation mark). Panel likelihood to enquire was 2.4: four personas said 'maybe' and uhnw said 'no', the brakes being the Advisor fee and commission, who is accountable on the day, a private channel and scale and security. None is confirmed in brand-facts.md, so none is answered in the post; they go to /wonderland-concierge as open questions. Lead magnet suggestion only (exists: false, not placed): a Dominican Republic or Caribbean edition of the magazine, like the existing Fiji and Dubai guides, would suit readers of this post if the business produces one.
